Needs changes before merge. The local checks passed. Two PR body requirements remain open.

This is the first review. I read the whole diff against current upstream main and checked its AGENTS.md.

What looks good:

- The cutter uses the render device. The window does not create a second device for the cut.
- The start guard and the CPU fallback have tests. A still frame does not cut or publish again.
- The layer serves the display. Verification and posting keep their existing paths.
- This is partial work. `Refs #3336` and `Refs #2629` correctly leave the remaining work open.

Local results:

The worktree is `.claude/worktrees/review-4001`. The trial merge has PR head `3aebb3a38500aae1c2356c11e0fc21b13eb78b04` as its first parent. Its second parent is upstream main `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`. Main is already an ancestor of the PR. The trial merge changes no file.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 30 steps, 0 failed. Tests: 2,154 passed, 15 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed. All 11 light tests passed.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test play_layer_gpu -- --nocapture`: 1 passed. The kernel ran on llvmpipe through Vulkan. Seven seek positions matched the CPU twin within tolerance. The device-without-compute case also passed.
- No changed fixture directory or import code requires the extra importer suites.

Mutations run by this reviewer:

1. Removed the `eye` and `refused` conditions from `start_cutter`. Three tests failed: `an_eye_that_does_not_trace_on_the_gpu_keeps_the_cpu_playback`, `an_eye_that_cannot_hold_the_layer_frame_ends_the_layer_playback`, and `the_layer_playback_ends_only_for_a_held_frame_off_the_gpu`. Restored the guard: all seven `play_layer_tests` passed.
2. Removed the no-twin guard from `set_layer`. `a_program_with_no_twin_op_keeps_the_layer_mode_off` failed. Restored the guard: the test passed.

Both mutations were temporary. The worktree is clean and matches the PR head. No review evidence was added to the branch.

Goldens moved: none. I checked the whole changed-file list. No golden, fixture, recorded NC program, CL program, or catalog file changed.

Requested before merge:

1. **Class: missing UI evidence.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window.rs:301` starts the new UI playback path. The PR body has no before/after screenshots and explicitly says that none exist. The review request requires screenshots for changes under `crates/ui`. Add before/after screenshots of the same Simulate scene. Name the adapter and the path shown. An unchanged intended picture does not waive this requirement. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Apply this evidence rule to the whole UI change.
2. **Class: unexplained test binary.** `crates/ui/tests/play_layer_gpu.rs:1` adds a top-level integration test binary. Current upstream AGENTS.md, **New tests join a directory suite**, requires a one-line reason in the PR body. That reason is absent. Add the device-isolation reason already stated at lines 5–6, or put the test in an existing suitable suite. Account for every new top-level test binary in the body.

Limits and notes:

- No hardware GPU, real window playback, concurrent drawing and compute, or wasm build was tested. The hardware performance claim remains unmeasured.
- Full heavy lanes were not run. Current upstream **Heavy lanes at review** reserves them for the cut. The author's reported `pocket3d_hsm` failure is tracked by #3886; this review did not reproduce that report.
- The existing large `State` and shell files grew slightly. This is a non-blocking file-size note.
- The PR is mergeable. I set `needs-rework` for the two body requirements. The draft stays a draft.
- The worktree and `review-4001` branch remain in place to keep the build warm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Missing UI evidence: the PR body now links [before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/359114e474e4d01f3e4c79a8dfe5feff19ef3690/pr-4001/simulate-before.png) and [after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/359114e474e4d01f3e4c79a8dfe5feff19ef3690/pr-4001/simulate-after.png) screenshots of the same Simulate scene. Both use llvmpipe via Vulkan and CPU playback. Both show the same paused stock picture. The body states the offscreen capture limits.
2. Unexplained test binary: the body now gives the device isolation reason for `play_layer_gpu.rs`. One test uses one graphics device in its own process (#3589, #3605).

Evidence check: remove either addition and the text check is RED. Restore it and the check is GREEN. No production code changed. A new code pin does not apply.

Head unchanged: `3aebb3a38500aae1c2356c11e0fc21b13eb78b04`.

Checks repeated on 2026-11-25 against `upstream/main` `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`:

- Quick gate: 30 steps, 0 failed; 2,154 passed, 15 ignored.
- Clippy for app and UI, all targets, `-D warnings`: passed.
- Heavy gate: 69 steps, 68 OK, 1 unexpected failure, 0 stalled (44.5 minutes). The failure is `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`: the import facet pin reads 5232 against 6228. This is the same failure reported in the original body (#3886).
- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored. No golden or catalog file changed.

Please re-review the two evidence changes.

**Verdict: clean.** This is a re-review of the same head. The two earlier findings are fixed in the PR body. I found no new blocker.

## Earlier findings

The earlier review is the comment of 2026-11-25T10:47:43Z. The author answered it in the "Addressed:" comment of 2026-11-25T11:47:53Z.

1. **Missing UI evidence: fixed.**
   - The body links before and after screenshots of the same Simulate scene at the same seek position.
   - The images are at `pr-4001/simulate-before.png` and `pr-4001/simulate-after.png` on commit `359114e47` of the fork. The GitHub API shows that this commit is on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The two files exist and have the same size (289,070 bytes). This agrees with the claim that the pixels are the same.
   - The body names the adapter (`llvmpipe`, Vulkan, software) and the path that is shown (CPU playback).
   - The body says that no hardware adapter was available. It says that the screenshots do not show the GPU layer path. This is the correct limit for this machine.
   - No image or review file is in the PR tree.
2. **Unexplained test binary: fixed.** The body says that `play_layer_gpu.rs` is the only new top-level test binary. It gives the reason: one test and one graphics device in its own process (#3589, #3605). This meets **New tests join a directory suite** in the current upstream `AGENTS.md`.

## Trial merge

- PR head: `3aebb3a38500aae1c2356c11e0fc21b13eb78b04` (unchanged since the earlier review).
- Upstream main moved from `d80dc6944` to `baad348f191a5f2261dc778ac3f9853aaf19ffa0` (133 files changed). The trial merge is clean. HEAD^1 is the PR head.
- No file of upstream main's new commits is also a file of this PR. I ran the checks again on the new merge.

## Local results on the new trial merge

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 30 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (6.1 min). This includes `ui suites: play_layer_gpu` and the seven `stock_play*` suites.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog`: 43 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- No file under `testdata/` or a fixture directory changed. No import code changed. The importer suites do not apply.

Note on the build: the first quick gate run stalled at the `ring` build script in `sccache cc`. A different session had the same `ring` compile held in `sccache` at that time. I ran the gate again with `RUSTC_WRAPPER` and `CC_WRAPPER` empty, and it was green. This is a problem of the host. It is not a problem of the PR.

## Safety tier

This PR does not change posted G-code, a gouge check, a collision check or geometry. It changes the display path of the stock playback. Verification and posting keep their existing paths. The two mutations of the earlier review are still valid for this head:

- `start_cutter` without the `eye` and `refused` conditions: three pins red. Restored: green.
- `set_layer` without the no-twin condition: `a_program_with_no_twin_op_keeps_the_layer_mode_off` red. Restored: green.

## Goldens moved

None. The PR changes no `*.nc`, `*.cl`, golden or `examples/catalog/**` file. The body says "None".

## Heavy lanes

The PR has `P2`. Under **Heavy lanes at review**, a `P2` PR gets no heavy step. The author reports a heavy run with one failure: `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` (import facet pin 5232 against 6228). The failure is at the model import. This PR changes no import code. Issue #3886 tracks this failure on main. It does not block this PR.

## Labels

- I remove `needs-rework`. The earlier review set it on this head, and this review closes those findings.
- I set `merge-ready`. The PR is mergeable and each step that I ran is green.

## Optional, non-blocking

- The test of hardware GPU playback, the window path and the wasm build is still not done. The body lists these items under "Not exercised".

Left for the maintainer: the only collaborator `pr-reviewer` marker on the head is set by the PR author's own account (mkinney) with no evidence of a different reviewer agent, and the diff is safety-tier stock simulation (GPU layer playback, S3c). Not counted as a review; not merged in the sweep.

Merge (coordinator of NeoTech): no refresh was necessary, the head merges cleanly with `main` at `baad348f1`. The merge relies on the clean collaborator review of 2026-11-25T14:06:55Z on head `3aebb3a38`. Nothing was pushed after that review.
